targets.old_statement: A vehicle parked beside a highway needs hazard or parking lamps after sunset, before sunrise or when visibility is less than one thousand feet.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A vehicle parked beside a highway needs hazard or parking lamps after sunset, before sunrise or when visibility is less than one thousand feet.
targets.statement: Parking beside or on the shoulder of a highway between sunset and sunrise, or whenever people or objects are not visible one thousand feet away, requires turning on hazard or parking lamps if the vehicle has them.
